parts.text: the summary must quote the changelog's own section words for its bullets: ### Fixed, ### Added or ### Changed, copied exactly
the release version and date quoted as a phrase from the Changelog (## [0.54.1] - 2026-11-04)

notes: The look gives only ONE quote requirement for line 1: the quote must say "## [0.54.1] - 2026-11-04" — the whole release heading (version AND date) is one page phrase, so it is a single phrase fact, not separate version and date facts.

The look's bullet phrase is a choice of three page words ("### Fixed" or "### Added" or "### Changed"); the catalogue's phrase shape takes one fixed phrase, so the first of the three is written and the other two are covered by the part's text.

Nothing checks: the latest release; "Summarise the latest release" (a summary's quality and accuracy need reading the text to judge); line 1 "under 80 words" (the page holds no word reading "word limit").

Line 1 is a facts line: its file output/steps/1.json holds results with one quote each and the filled values; the "exactly 3 bullets" and "under 80 words" rules are left to code (line 1, ~ rules 1 and 2).

refused.reason: each list item's label must be one of the changelog's own section words — the page offers three alternatives (### Fixed / ### Added / ### Changed), which one fixed phrase fact cannot express
the latest release — which release is latest cannot be expressed as a shape and a rule
